shared_elements: carved low-relief imagery on a flat vertical panel
animal/creature imagery (bird-like forms in B; winged anthropomorphic figure in A)
arm and hand forms rendered against the body
justification: Both panels show profile-oriented creatures in low relief and both include arms/hands rendered along a body, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes: A is dominated by a single large, anatomically detailed winged human figure with a beard, patterned garment and raised hand, while B stacks multiple small schematic animals, birds and a snake-like creature in registers separated by a zigzag/ladder band. The manner of depiction is opposed — dense naturalistic musculature and feather detail versus flat, outline-only schematic silhouettes — and there is no shared compositional scheme.
